podcast.title: Country Music Nominee (1974)
podcast.body: Marie Osmond was among the established female country vocalists nominated for Best Country Vocal Performance Female at the 1974 Grammys, an award that was controversially won by Olivia Newton-John. "Marie Osmond."

podcast.title: The Donnie & Marie Show (1975-1979)
podcast.body: Marie co-hosted this successful variety show with her brother Donnie from 1975 to 1979, which was notable for its sibling rivalry chemistry, musical performances, and inclusion of ice skating. "Donnie and Marie had a very good sibling rivalry chemistry They could also sing, every week they did a skit based on I'm a little bit country, I'm a little bit rock and roll."

podcast.title: Las Vegas Residency (2008-2019)
podcast.body: Marie and Donnie Osmond concluded an 11-year run with their show in Las Vegas in November 2019, with Marie being 60 years old at the time. "Surely they did not think that 40 years later they would have another 11 year run with their show in Las Vegas But they did, it came to an end in November 2019 when 61 year old Donnie and 60 year old Marie closed out their last show in Las Vegas."
